_source: The industry statistics the site quotes, each with the citation it carries. One place, so the same figure cannot drift between the homepage, a course page and a guide. Sourced by the PM, 13 Sep 2026 (statistics-copy.md). Change here and rebuild.

source.en: NHBF State of the Industry survey, April 2025
source.cy: Arolwg Cyflwr y Diwydiant yr NHBF, Ebrill 2025

en.card: of hair and beauty businesses were making a profit in the NHBF's April 2025 survey — 39% were breaking even and 21% trading at a loss.
en.sentence: In the NHBF's April 2025 State of the Industry survey, 40% of hair and beauty businesses were making a profit. Thirty-nine per cent were breaking even and 21% were trading at a loss.
en.clause: in the NHBF's April 2025 survey only 40% of hair and beauty businesses were making a profit, with 39% breaking even and 21% trading at a loss

cy.card: o fusnesau gwallt a harddwch oedd yn gwneud elw yn arolwg yr NHBF ym mis Ebrill 2025 — roedd 39% yn torri'n wastad a 21% yn masnachu ar golled.
cy.sentence: Yn arolwg Cyflwr y Diwydiant yr NHBF ym mis Ebrill 2025, roedd 40% o fusnesau gwallt a harddwch yn gwneud elw. Roedd tri deg naw y cant yn torri'n wastad a 21% yn masnachu ar golled.
cy.clause: yn arolwg yr NHBF ym mis Ebrill 2025 dim ond 40% o fusnesau gwallt a harddwch oedd yn gwneud elw, gyda 39% yn torri'n wastad a 21% yn masnachu ar golled

source.en: NHBF written evidence to the House of Commons, 26 September 2024
source.cy: Tystiolaeth ysgrifenedig yr NHBF i Dŷ'r Cyffredin, 26 Medi 2024

en.card: of workers in hairdressing and barbering are self-employed — the NHBF's evidence to Parliament, September 2024. We train people for the industry as it really is.
en.sentence: Some 62% of workers in hairdressing and barbering are self-employed — the NHBF's evidence to Parliament, September 2024.
en.clause: some 62% of workers in hairdressing and barbering are self-employed, by the NHBF's evidence to Parliament in September 2024

cy.card: o weithwyr trin gwallt a barbro sy'n hunangyflogedig — tystiolaeth yr NHBF i'r Senedd yn San Steffan, Medi 2024. Rydym yn hyfforddi pobl ar gyfer y diwydiant fel y mae go iawn.
cy.sentence: Mae tua 62% o weithwyr trin gwallt a barbro yn hunangyflogedig — tystiolaeth yr NHBF i'r Senedd yn San Steffan, Medi 2024.
cy.clause: mae tua 62% o weithwyr trin gwallt a barbro yn hunangyflogedig, yn ôl tystiolaeth yr NHBF i'r Senedd yn San Steffan ym Medi 2024

apprentice_starts.status: RESTATEMENT — the original '18,170 to 7,350, UK, since 2015' pair is unverified (statistics-copy.md §3, option b). If Mark supplies the source, replace this entry and rebuild.

en.card: apprentice starts in hair and beauty between 2017-18 and 2019-20 — down to around 7,000 a year in England; the NHBF projected fewer than 3,400 UK starts by 2025.
en.sentence: Apprentice intake in hair and beauty fell by 4,500 between 2017-18 and 2019-20, to around 7,000 starts a year in England, and the NHBF projected fewer than 3,400 UK starts by 2025.
en.clause: apprentice intake in hair and beauty fell by 4,500 in two years to around 7,000 starts a year in England, and the NHBF projected fewer than 3,400 UK starts by 2025

cy.card: o ddechreuadau prentisiaid gwallt a harddwch rhwng 2017-18 a 2019-20 — i lawr i tua 7,000 y flwyddyn yn Lloegr; rhagwelodd yr NHBF lai na 3,400 o ddechreuadau yn y DU erbyn 2025.
cy.sentence: Cwympodd nifer y prentisiaid gwallt a harddwch 4,500 rhwng 2017-18 a 2019-20, i tua 7,000 o ddechreuadau y flwyddyn yn Lloegr, a rhagwelodd yr NHBF lai na 3,400 o ddechreuadau yn y DU erbyn 2025.
cy.clause: cwympodd nifer y prentisiaid gwallt a harddwch 4,500 mewn dwy flynedd i tua 7,000 o ddechreuadau y flwyddyn yn Lloegr, a rhagwelodd yr NHBF lai na 3,400 o ddechreuadau yn y DU erbyn 2025
